question: In the photocatalytic ozonation of antibiotics with bimetallic Pd/Cu on rutile TiO2 and g-C3N4, what gas flow rate, inlet ozone concentration and catalyst loading were used?
rendered: The document states that the photocatalytic ozonation experiments employed metal-doped TiO2 (rutile) and C3N4 nanostructures at a catalyst loading of 150 mg/dm3. The gas flow rate and the inlet ozone concentration were maintained at 0.4 Ndm3/min and 37 mgO3/Ndm3, respectively.
